Title: RedMed Band
Body (HTML):
Blank medical-ID wristband. Passive 13.56 MHz HF NFC with a genuine NXP NTAG216 chip (888 bytes). Ships empty and unlocked — the RedMed iOS app writes your card. No Bluetooth. No RedMed cloud for your profile.

How it works

  1. Put the band on.
  2. In RedMed, open the NFC tab and Write (Face ID).
  3. A stranger or EMT taps a phone to the band (~1–2″). The card opens in the browser. No app install. No login.

Walk-by distance (~6–8″) does not fire the band. Only a deliberate antenna tap opens the card.

What’s included

  • Adult silicone wristband
  • NXP NTAG216, ISO 14443 Type 2, NDEF blank
  • Outer face ready for medical-ID engraving on production runs

What’s not included / not this product

  • No pre-written URL or social-media link
  • No payment / access-control card reader mode
  • Not a Bluetooth tracker
  • Not a medical device and not a substitute for calling emergency services

Requires iPhone with NFC and the RedMed app to program. Passerby view works on any modern NFC phone via the browser.
